name: Iowa State RISE with WiSE Summer Experience
org: Program for Women in Science and Engineering, Iowa State University
what_you_do: A one week stay on the Iowa State campus. Pick one of two hands-on STEM tracks, Engineering or Life Sciences, taught by faculty, staff and students. You also get a taste of college life.
who_can_apply: High school students entering their junior or senior year. The page says 'All students are welcome.'
pay_detail: The page lists $450 through June 26 or $500 for late registration (this may be last year's price). It covers housing, meals, a t-shirt and on-campus costs. You can ask for financial help on the registration form.
duration: One week. Tentative 2027 sessions: July 11 to 15 and July 18 to 22.
deadline_text: Applications open in January, per the page. The page gives no year and no closing date. It does not say if the $450 price applies to 2027.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Summer 2027 Interest Form on the page. It tells you when applications open. Then register online. You ask for financial help on the registration form.
notes: The page only says applications open 'in January'. No exact opening day is known. Dates are marked tentative on the page.
